testsuite.name: fi.gekkio.ghidraboy.SoftwareCallAdversarialTest

testcase.name: matched ordinary nested RET permits precise reversible false noReturn and CALL_RETURN repair()
nested returning witness never excuses an unrelated BRANCH override()
same native interface rejects changed canonical and alias payload then follows reviewed new physical target()
legacy far-call supplemental endpoint cannot silently become a helper endpoint()
same-space first continuation still needs banked view for later window crossing()
canonical local branches and conditional RET preserve raw flags registers and live return words()
unprepared callee requires explicit rooted discovery before executable validation()
continuation fetch permissions are proof premises rather than only later drift checks()
ordinary analysis refines decoder operand DATA into WRITE without invalidating the view but user references remain protected()
registry v3 record is rejected then public removal and reviewed reapplication produce current semantics()
unprepared helper requires explicit rooted discovery before executable validation()
initial wrong primary ordinary CALL reference is rejected without silent normalization()
initial wrong CALL override is rejected before ownership can bless it()
later continuation fetches and instruction operand bytes also require immutable ROM()
backwards conditional continuation edge preserves finite loop in canonical and mapped native roots()
